Scan an R Project for Package Dependencies and Compiled HPC Toolchains

Source: R/env_scan.R
scan_project_env.Rd

Inspects renv.lock, DESCRIPTION, and R/Rmd/Quarto source scripts to build a unified manifest of R packages, R version, compiled toolchains (Rcpp, cmdstanr, RTMB, TMB, rstan, JAGS, sf, etc.), and required Debian/Ubuntu system libraries for container packaging via build_apptainer_def().

Usage

scan_project_env(
  path = NULL,
  renv_lock = NULL,
  description = NULL,
  scripts = NULL,
  extra_packages = character(),
  include_suggests = FALSE
)

Arguments

path

Optional project root directory to scan automatically.

renv_lock

Optional explicit path to an renv.lock file.

description

Optional explicit path to a DESCRIPTION file.

scripts

Optional character vector of .R, .Rmd, or .qmd script paths to scan for package imports.

extra_packages

Character vector of additional R packages to include explicitly.

include_suggests

Logical; if TRUE, also includes Suggests from DESCRIPTION. Default FALSE.

Value

An S3 object of class "slurmpilot_env" containing r_version, packages (a tibble), toolchains, apt_packages, env_vars, needs_makevars, has_renv_lock, renv_lock_path, sources_scanned, and env_hash.

See also

toolchain_registry(), build_apptainer_def()

Examples

env <- scan_project_env(extra_packages = c("lme4", "cmdstanr", "Rcpp"))
print(env)
#> 
#> ── slurmpilot HPC Environment Manifest 
#> • R version: 4.6.2 (env hash: a4071f53e82e)
#> • Packages detected: 3 (renv.lock: FALSE)
#> • Compiled toolchains: cpp, cmdstan, linear_algebra
#> • System apt packages (11): build-essential, ca-certificates, cmake, curl, g++,
#>   gfortran, liblapack-dev, libnlopt-dev, ...
